title: Catch-up Gauntlet coverage review of closed features
goal: Every closed NERV feature is classed: NERV-specific case needed, general capability (gauntlet-protocol request), or no model-facing behaviour
acceptance: docs/reviews/gauntlet-coverage/2026-11-24.md (or the run date) lists each closed feature since F-074 with its class and reason
Each NERV-specific gap becomes a proposed case in F-120-T02 with expected outcome; general gaps are listed as requests for gauntlet-protocol, not as NERV work

Starts from the "Area coverage" list in docs/test-capability-index.md: every area with 0 mapped cases (coding, code-review, math, logic-planning, cad-3d, backlog-management, estimation, research, audio-video, scheduling-time at 2026-11-24) ends with a decision: NERV system-pack case, gauntlet-protocol request, or a stated reason to skip
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no personal data.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
